<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 700" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <style>
        .wall-outer { fill: #fcfcfd; stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .wall-major { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.8; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .wall-inner { fill: none; stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .door-leaf { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .door-swing { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-dasharray: 2.5,2.5; }
        .fixture { fill: #f1f5f9; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1; }
        .fixture-dash { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3,3; }
        .crane-rail { fill: none; stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6,4; }
        .safety-fence { fill: none; stroke: #ef4444; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: 4,3; }
        .room-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; fill: #475569; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; user-select: none; }
    </style>

    <!-- Outer Perimeter (1100 x 600) -->
    <rect x="50" y="50" width="1100" height="600" class="wall-outer" />

    <!-- ==================== L-SHAPED CORRIDOR ==================== -->
    <!-- Vertical Spine (x: 220..270, y: 50..650) -->
    <!-- Horizontal Spine (y: 320..370, x: 270..900) -->
    <text x="245" y="240" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px; fill: #94a3b8; writing-mode: vertical-lr; letter-spacing: 2px;">CORRIDOR</text>
    <text x="540" y="348" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px; fill: #94a3b8; letter-spacing: 2px;">◄ SAFETY TRANSIT CORRIDOR ►</text>

    <!-- ==================== WEST BLOCK: TECH & AMENITIES ==================== -->
    <!-- North wall of IT / Server is outer wall y=50 -->

    <!-- MDF Server Room: x: 50..220, y: 50..180 (Rack centered at 135, 115) -->
    <line x1="50" y1="180" x2="220" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- East wall of Server Room with door from corridor (y: 100..130) -->
    <line x1="220" y1="50" x2="220" y2="100" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="220" y1="100" x2="190" y2="100" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 220,130 A 30,30 0 0,1 190,100" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="220" y1="130" x2="220" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <text x="65" y="75" class="room-label">MDF SERVER ROOM</text>

    <!-- Plant Engineering & IT Office: x: 50..220, y: 180..270 -->
    <line x1="50" y1="270" x2="220" y2="270" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- East wall door from corridor (y: 210..240) -->
    <line x1="220" y1="180" x2="220" y2="210" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="220" y1="210" x2="190" y2="210" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 220,240 A 30,30 0 0,1 190,210" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="220" y1="240" x2="220" y2="270" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="65" y="202" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">PLANT ENGINEERING</text>
    <rect x="55" y="225" width="45" height="22" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Quality Control & Testing Lab (Cleanroom): x: 50..220, y: 270..460 (Rack centered at 135, 380) -->
    <line x1="50" y1="460" x2="220" y2="460" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Airlock Gowning Room: x: 165..220, y: 270..330 -->
    <line x1="165" y1="270" x2="165" y2="330" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="165" y1="330" x2="220" y2="330" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Outer door from corridor into Airlock (x=220, y: 285..315) -->
    <line x1="220" y1="270" x2="220" y2="285" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="220" y1="285" x2="195" y2="285" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 220,315 A 30,30 0 0,1 195,285" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="220" y1="315" x2="220" y2="460" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Inner door from Airlock into Testing Lab (x=165, y: 285..315) -->
    <line x1="165" y1="285" x2="140" y2="285" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 165,315 A 30,30 0 0,1 140,285" class="door-swing" />

    <text x="65" y="295" class="room-label">TESTING LAB</text>
    <text x="172" y="285" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7px;">AIRLOCK</text>
    <rect x="65" y="320" width="50" height="35" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Staff Amenities (Lockers & WC): x: 50..220, y: 460..650 -->
    <line x1="50" y1="550" x2="220" y2="550" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Corridor door into Lockers (x=220, y: 485..515) -->
    <line x1="220" y1="460" x2="220" y2="485" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="220" y1="485" x2="190" y2="485" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 220,515 A 30,30 0 0,1 190,485" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="220" y1="515" x2="220" y2="650" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="65" y="482" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">LOCKERS</text>

    <!-- WC Restrooms: x: 50..220, y: 550..650 -->
    <line x1="135" y1="550" x2="135" y2="650" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Door to WC Men (y=550, x: 75..105) -->
    <line x1="75" y1="550" x2="75" y2="575" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 105,550 A 30,30 0 0,1 75,575" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="65" y="605" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">WC M</text>
    <!-- Door to WC Women (y=550, x: 160..190) -->
    <line x1="160" y1="550" x2="160" y2="575" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 190,550 A 30,30 0 0,1 160,575" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="150" y="605" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">WC W</text>

    <!-- Main Plant Entrance on South wall at y=650 (x: 230..260) -->
    <line x1="230" y1="650" x2="230" y2="625" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 245,650 A 15,15 0 0,0 230,625" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="260" y1="650" x2="260" y2="625" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 245,650 A 15,15 0 0,1 260,625" class="door-swing" />

    <!-- ==================== CENTER PRODUCTION: CNC & ROBOTICS ==================== -->
    <!-- CNC Workshop (North of horizontal corridor, x: 270..900, y: 50..320) -->
    <!-- Wall separating Corridor and CNC along y=320 -->
    <line x1="270" y1="50" x2="270" y2="320" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="270" y1="320" x2="420" y2="320" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Double doors into CNC (x: 420..470) -->
    <line x1="420" y1="320" x2="420" y2="295" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 445,320 A 25,25 0 0,0 420,295" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="470" y1="320" x2="470" y2="295" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 445,320 A 25,25 0 0,1 470,295" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="470" y1="320" x2="720" y2="320" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Forklift Parts Gate into CNC (x: 720..780) -->
    <line x1="720" y1="320" x2="780" y2="320" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="780" y1="320" x2="900" y2="320" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- CNC Machinery & Overhead Crane -->
    <text x="300" y="75" class="room-label">CNC MACHINING WORKSHOP</text>
    <line x1="290" y1="100" x2="880" y2="100" class="crane-rail" />
    <line x1="290" y1="280" x2="880" y2="280" class="crane-rail" />
    <!-- Machine Footprints (rack centered at 580, 185) -->
    <rect x="320" y="125" width="80" height="48" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="440" y="125" width="80" height="48" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="660" y="125" width="80" height="48" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="780" y="125" width="80" height="48" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="320" y="215" width="70" height="35" class="fixture-dash" />

    <!-- Robotics Bay (South of horizontal corridor, x: 270..900, y: 370..650) -->
    <!-- Wall separating Corridor and Robotics along y=370 -->
    <line x1="270" y1="370" x2="270" y2="650" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="270" y1="370" x2="420" y2="370" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Double doors into Robotics (x: 420..470) -->
    <line x1="420" y1="370" x2="420" y2="395" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 445,370 A 25,25 0 0,1 420,395" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="470" y1="370" x2="470" y2="395" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 445,370 A 25,25 0 0,0 470,395" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="470" y1="370" x2="720" y2="370" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Forklift Parts Gate into Robotics (x: 720..780) -->
    <line x1="720" y1="370" x2="780" y2="370" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="780" y1="370" x2="900" y2="370" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- Robotics Bay Automation Cells (rack centered at 580, 510) -->
    <text x="300" y="415" class="room-label">ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION BAY</text>
    <!-- Cell 1 -->
    <rect x="330" y="445" width="160" height="120" class="safety-fence" />
    <circle cx="410" cy="505" r="22" class="fixture" />
    <!-- Cell 1 Safety Interlock Gate (y: 445, x: 395..425) -->
    <line x1="395" y1="445" x2="395" y2="465" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 425,445 A 20,20 0 0,1 395,465" class="door-swing" />

    <!-- Cell 2 -->
    <rect x="670" y="445" width="160" height="120" class="safety-fence" />
    <circle cx="750" cy="505" r="22" class="fixture" />
    <!-- Cell 2 Safety Interlock Gate (y: 445, x: 735..765) -->
    <line x1="735" y1="445" x2="735" y2="465" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 765,445 A 20,20 0 0,1 735,465" class="door-swing" />

    <!-- ==================== EAST WING: UTILITIES & MAINTENANCE ==================== -->
    <!-- Major Firewall along x=900 separating Production and Maintenance -->
    <line x1="900" y1="50" x2="900" y2="320" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Double Fire Doors from Horizontal Corridor into Maintenance (y: 320..370) -->
    <line x1="900" y1="320" x2="925" y2="320" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 900,345 A 25,25 0 0,0 925,320" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="900" y1="370" x2="925" y2="370" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 900,345 A 25,25 0 0,1 925,370" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="900" y1="370" x2="900" y2="650" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- Compressor Room: x: 900..1150, y: 50..210 -->
    <line x1="900" y1="210" x2="980" y2="210" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Door from Maintenance into Compressor Room (x: 980..1010) -->
    <line x1="980" y1="210" x2="980" y2="185" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 1010,210 A 30,30 0 0,0 980,185" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="1010" y1="210" x2="1150" y2="210" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="920" y="80" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">COMPRESSORS</text>
    <rect x="930" y="110" width="60" height="40" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1030" y="110" width="60" height="40" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Maintenance Workshop: x: 900..1150, y: 210..470 (Rack centered at 1020, 350) -->
    <text x="920" y="240" class="room-label">MAINTENANCE & TOOL CRIB</text>
    <!-- Tool Dispenser Cage -->
    <rect x="920" y="270" width="65" height="50" class="fixture-dash" />
    <text x="928" y="295" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7px; fill: #94a3b8;">MATRIX CRIB</text>
    <!-- Workbenches -->
    <rect x="1075" y="240" width="55" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1075" y="280" width="55" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1075" y="380" width="55" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1075" y="420" width="55" height="25" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Switchgear & Generator Room: x: 900..1150, y: 470..650 -->
    <line x1="900" y1="470" x2="980" y2="470" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Door from Maintenance into Switchgear Room (x: 980..1010) -->
    <line x1="980" y1="470" x2="980" y2="495" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 1010,470 A 30,30 0 0,1 980,495" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="1010" y1="470" x2="1150" y2="470" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="920" y="500" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">MAIN SWITCHGEAR</text>
    <rect x="930" y="530" width="100" height="30" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="930" y="580" width="100" height="30" class="fixture" />
</svg>
